definitions.season: Season start year. 2026 means the 2026/27 season, which may be partial.
definitions.stake: Flat stake of 1.00 unit on the named team to win. staked equals bets.
definitions.roi: profit / staked. If the team wins, that bet's profit is odds - 1; otherwise profit is -1. roi is null when bets is 0. A positive roi means always betting that team at the closing price made money.
definitions.winPct: won / played * 100, using every completed match. Null when played is 0.
definitions.closingOdds: Pinnacle closing PSCH/PSCD/PSCA when all three prices are decimal odds greater than 1. Otherwise Pinnacle PSH/PSD/PSA (or PH/PD/PA). Otherwise Bet365 B365H/B365D/B365A, or B365CH/B365CD/B365CA when the file has no pre-closing Bet365 columns. oddsSource on each match is PSC, PS, or B365.
definitions.recordVsRoi: played/won/drawn/lost include every completed match. bets/staked/returned/profit/roi/avgOdds include only matches with a closing price for that team.
definitions.homeAway: Home uses matches the team played at home and the home closing price. Away uses the away closing price. Overall is both.
definitions.impliedProbability: Calibration observes each of home, draw, and away once per priced match. Raw implied probability is 1/odds. Overround is removed by dividing by (1/home + 1/draw + 1/away). actualWinRate is wins/outcomes in the bucket. avgImpliedProb is the mean de-vigged probability. sumImpliedProb and sumOdds are the totals behind those averages so buckets can be recombined.
definitions.buckets: Half-open intervals on decimal closing odds: minOdds <= odds < maxOdds. The last bucket has maxOdds null. Favorites from 1.20 to 1.50 use 0.05-wide buckets. outcomes counts the three 1X2 results, not matches.
definitions.ligaMx: Liga MX comes from https://www.football-data.co.uk/new/MEX.csv because openfootball/mexico is not available. Coverage starts in 2012/13. The file has no separate playoff flag, so published Liga MX rows are included as-is.
